items.title: Russian online retail warehouses hit by deadly Ukrainian strikes
items.summary: Drones targeted Wildberries facilities near Moscow and in Tambov. Ukraine's leader called them "major logistics facilities" supplying "sanctioned components".

items.title: Many Ukrainian soldiers outraged over removal of defence minister, troops tell BBC
items.summary: Protests erupted in Ukraine on Thursday after Mykhailo Fedorov's removal - and now soldiers are also criticising the move.

items.title: US strikes hit Iran for seventh consecutive night
items.summary: Iran has retaliated against US allies in the region, with Kuwait reporting that a power and water plant had been hit.

items.title: Trump threatens new Canada tariffs over fires sending 'filthy' air into US cities
items.summary: Canadian leader Mark Carney says both the US and Canada have an equal responsibility to fight climate change, which experts say are worsening wildfire conditions.

items.title: Space start-up launches India’s first commercial rocket designed for orbit
items.summary: India's first space-tech unicorn Skyroot Aerospace successfully launched Vikram-1 on Saturday.

items.title: Laos says it can't determine cause of tourist deaths linked to methanol
items.summary: Officials say they have no evidence of poisoning over the 2024 deaths because autopsies were not conducted.

items.title: Indian activist on hunger strike for 20 days forcibly taken to hospital
items.summary: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke has now begun an indefinite fast in Sonam Wangchuk's place.

items.title: White House defends Argentina team over Falklands banner
items.summary: The comments could further fuel the row over the incident, which has seen Downing Street back calls for Fifa to investigate.
